newsitem.title: CHILE: Local buyers push Chile shares to highest 97 close.
newsitem.headline: Local buyers push Chile shares to highest 97 close.

text.p: Chilean shares closed stronger at their highest point this year with the bolsa extending its rally despite the absence of foreigners due to the Independence Day holiday, said traders.
Monday's opening is seen erratic with local players waiting to see Wall Street's mood after the long weekend, they said.
The 40-share .IPSA index ended up 0.44 percent at 137.24 points. Its previous highest close was 137.07 points on June 12.
The general .IGPA index gained 0.35 percent to 5,866.76 points amid 11.4 billion pesos.
